response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform design; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang with minimal evidence of cloud compute leadership, distributed systems, or C++-centric architecture.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical mentoring via workshops
Proven experience in building scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, real-time microservices)
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years of C++ programming as required
Lacks documented experience in cloud compute platforms or distributed systems leadership
Minimal exposure to cloud-native infrastructure (AWS CDK used, but not as architect/lead)
